Introduction

Camila is a Cuban-Canadian singer under JYP Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group GIRLSET (originally known as VCHA), which was formed through the survival show "A2K". She debuted with the group on January 26, 2024, with their first single album 'Girls of the Year".

Before joining A2K, Camila was a finalist on The Voice Kids in 2016 with her brother, Zion. Previously, they had made it to the finale of The Junior Voice Quebec before making their rounds to The Voice Kids: France.
